notes.title: Dev build now live on public branch!
notes.content:
We pushed all the changes that were being made on dev branch to public branch. 
Some additions are still incomplete, but being worked on and improved over the coming months. 

[previewyoutube=v6Fakz0k_ME;full][/previewyoutube]

The new patch includes:

- Turning based on mouse rotation
- Head turning 
- Character acceleration 
- Sleeping (Press H to rest and then J to sleep; J and H to stand up)
- Footstep sound improvements
- Basic playable aquatics (predators and prey)
- Location updates (Aran Desert & Sanctuary)
- New herbivore food indicator
- Performance improvements, etc.

We hope you enjoy the update! 

- ATP Dev Team

notes.title: [Development Branch] Head Turning Update + Fixes and Performance Improvements
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Head turning has been added to the beta branch "development" and is awaiting testing. 
We also fixed some minor issues which got introduced with the last patch and did some small performance improvements. 
We are aware of the bugs that let you move and partially attack during resting and sleeping. These are issues, which can only be fixed through an engine update, which will happen at a later point in time. 

Here is a short video of the new additions and changes that have been made with the last patches. 

[previewyoutube=v6Fakz0k_ME;full][/previewyoutube]

- ATP Dev Team

notes.title: Aquatics on Dev Branch
notes.content:
Aquatic animals are available for testing on development (beta) branch!

New animals: 
- Mosasaurus 
- Ophthalmosaurus
- Leedsichthys
- Dunkleosteus 
- Helicoprion
- Mawsonia 
- Coelacanth 
- Doryaspis
- Drepanaspis  

They are still heavily being worked on, but playable. 
Hunger and thirst are disabled for aquatic creatures. Hunger will be enabled as soon as underwater eating is implemented. 
Some sounds will get a rework, especially attack sounds.

notes.title: Public Branch Patch
notes.content:
We moved the current build from development branch to public branch. 
A lot of changes have been made since the last time we patched this version. A large portion of the changelog got lost due to logistical changes, which unfortunately cost us months of development time. 

We are aware of some issues regardling replication and dedicated servers not working right now, however we are working on them and will let you know when they are fixed. 

Also as we stated in several posts before, the new builds don't support Linux and Mac anymore. However your game will work on Windows or you can switch to the beta Branch Linux/Mac, which contains a copy of the last version of the game. 

We are slowly getting back on track. Thanks to the people, who have never given up on us.

notes.title: Update Version 0.1.0.1039
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28583024/805bcf7819c5b34b73819273604f461443bd4ca8.png[/img]

Upgraded: to Unreal Engine 4.18
Refactored: Eating/Drinking/Stamina/Sprinting/Health for shared functionality in-between aquatics 
Disabled: Halloween event
Disabled: Collision on small objects like tiny stones and branches
Disabled: Skylight recapture
Disabled: Cloud density change on all maps, since it is causing massive frame drops on medium and low end computers
Updated: Day-night-cycle length. A full cycle ends after 60 minutes instead of 90
Updated: Level art LOD's 
Updated: Asset shader to support different overlays like snow, moss and more 
Updated: Skysphere to 4.18
Updated: Foliage master material to allow us to easily switch between seasons, if needed
Updated: Min occlusion on all maps
Updated: Psittaco camera position to be closer
Updated: Edible objects will now despawn and respawn after a while depending on food value
Updated: Water post processing to be less dark
Updated: Gallimimus model and textures, since the old model had UV issues 
Updated: UI and font to be compatible with the new localization
Optimized: Network
Optimized: Several level art and character textures
Optimized: Trees. They now have 70-80% less polys, yay!
Improved: Animation blueprints. 
Fixed: Movement not stopping on death 
Fixed: Dinosaurs could jump while eating and drinking.
New: Discord Rich Presence integration (wip)
New: Rivershader and winter foliage variations (demo map only for now) 
New: Mushrooms, flowers and berries are a new food source 
New: Edible trees will now be green/red (depending on season) and have yellow falling leaves around them as well as a slight glow
New: Localization - Added German, English, French, Dutch, Italian, Hungarian & Portuguese (Brazil). Please let us know if a translation is wrong or if you want to help with the translation of other languages. 
Hotfix 1039: Disabled aquatics.

We spent a lot of time working on the aquatics, but they are still having some issues that need to be sorted out and they will also get a complete movement code overhaul later at some point.

notes.title: Aquatics update & Halloween event
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28583024/4234d5f7e7a0d17540d3f0be64b57b80008abc36.jpg[/img]

The next patch will be delayed by a couple of days, since we have to fix a bunch of  bugs that sneaked in with the addition of the aquatics. So the Halloween event will last a few days longer than planned. 

The aquatics update will feature the following playable animals:
Mosasaurus
Dunkleosteus
Helicoprion
Leedsichthys
Rhizodus
Ophthalmosaurus

We also have Mawsonia, Coelacanth, Doryaspis and Drepanaspis in the making, but we haven't decided yet, if we will make these playable or not. All of these wouldn't really have any attacks and Doryaspis & Drepanaspis are very small (the size of Archaeopteryx and tinier) and would be hard to spot underwater, which makes them rather pure AI candidates, which appear in swarms rather than solo. 

Once the aquatics update is out, we will continue to work on the ecosystem mode, which means it will be our main focus in the coming updates and the addition of new species will slow down, maybe even be delayed until post full release of the game, since we currently have enough animals for the ecosystem management part. 

We know, that some of you are excited to see new animals, but we feel that adding new dinosaurs to the game, in it's current state, slows our actual progress down and just delays the release of the main part of the game.

If you have any questions, feel free to join our Discord, where you can also find a few aquatic update sneak peeks:  https://discord.gg/VsEhawK

Also we are aware of the server issues and are still trying to resolve the problem. Until then let us know, if you get a timeout message and we will restart them asap. (Note: You can't join the Test Server on the public branch!)

We hope you have a happy Halloween!

notes.title: Halloween Event Patch 0.1.0.875
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28583024/e1aa33407610d5f4d942847758388a203ef1b41a.png[/img]

New: The Halloween update is finally here! Gather 100 claws and find a shrine to permanently unlock 1 of 7 Halloween themed skins! 
The event takes place on all 3 server maps (Vulture Plains, Aran Desert and Sanctuary) and will last until November 1st, so you have plenty of time to unlock your new swag!
Disabled: Motion blur
Fixed: Pachy's diet class, which resulted in a lower food regeneration when players were eating plants
Fixed: Message Box Error Messages were not working and always displayed 'You were banned' 
Fixed: Kick Reason not working on message boxes
Fixed: Possible UI Bugs
Fixed: Abort / Disconnect button not working in Shipping Builds.
Fixed: Dev / Admin Tags not showing up on listen servers + Developer Only Skins not working
Fixed: Invert X / Y axis setting not working and not saving
Fixed: Remove Chat Settings Option
Fixed: Ping bug with server list
Added: Show HUD Settings Option
Added: Mouse Sensitivity X and Y Option
Added: Kelp and seaweed
Added: Underwater cavesystem to Vulture Plains
Added: Gender selection to character selection (not functional yet) 
Updated: Underwater caustics effect
Updated: Steam Client Redist for Linux
Updated: Waterplane material and water post processing
Updated: Cavesystem post process settings
Updated: Vulkan Redist 
Updated: Ignore list and upgraded material assets to 4.17 format
Updated: Post process offset setting on several maps
Increased: Galli's eating animation rate scale
Increased: Psittaco's sprint animation rate scale
Lowered: Pachy's stamina, health and attack damage
Lowered: Stego health
Optimized: Vulture Plains map
Optimized: Several foliage meshes
Optimized: Animation Blueprint
Optimized: Player List UI Updates
Improved: Night vision now works in a better way and doesn't break on death
Improved: Network smoothing
Improved: Player List + Ping is now accurate

Note: The Halloween skins won't be allowed on the realism server once the event is over. 

Edit: Enable your HUD in the settings. We will do a hotfix in a few minutes to have the HUD enabled by default.

notes.title: Update Version 0.1.0.548
notes.content:
New: Stamina now regenerates 2x as fast while resting
Added: Health regen when > 50% Food. Health regens faster when resting
Added: Second attack to Coelophysis
Fixed: Reduced eating/drinking target distance by half
Fixed: being able to drink while swimming
Fixed: Game HUD was still appearing in the character selection screen for a few seconds
Fixed: Game HUD wasn't being shown when logging back in after dying on character selection
Fixed: Bug where your stamina would regen past the maximum value
Fixed: Players now can no longer run when they don't have any stamina 
Improved: Game Performance

notes.title: Update Version 0.1.0.536
notes.content:
Added: basic hunger/thirst/stamina system, carnivores & herbivores can eat dead bodies to fill up their hunger bar (eating plants is wip)
Added: Drinkable water
Added: new spawn points to Aran Desert; players will now spawn around the large oasis 
Added: stats UI, which shows the players health, hunger, stamina and thirst 
Added: suicide button to Escape menu; players don't have to use the console anymore
Added: New mini map "ArchaeoKingdom" to map selection (Host menu) 
Fixed: hitboxes on all dinosaurs; damage should now get applied like intended 
Nerfed: Tyrannosaurus, Triceratops, Styracosaurus and Gallimimus
Updated: second Tyrannosaurus skin set 
Updated: nametag visibility 
Updated: AranDesert map; something strange happened there...

notes.title: Update Version 0.1.0.497
notes.content:
Fixed hitboxes on dinosaurs 
Added 4 more Styracosaurus skins 
Nametags shouldn't change position anymore, when the player crouches 
Aligned swimming animations of all dinosaurs to water surface 
Disabled skylight recapture on all maps, which caused performance issues and larger framedrops every few seconds 
Added new character selections with light sources to all maps 
Fixed: Hosting of listen servers 
Fixed: Mesh deformation on Styracos beak, while using call
Fixed: Vocal call duplication 
Possible dead body running fix
Updated: Stego Walkcycle
Updated: Tyrannosaurus Runcycle
Updated: texture groups of UI elements and character textures 
New: Game now discards unused texture quality levels for lower memory performance impact
